answer: The wander history is re-read at each close, sparrow lists the contradictions, and ledge records the voided pairs. An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 9 epochs, thus its own output eventually convicts it. Bonded capital sits idle for 20 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
